anomalies.description: Multiple players from Montreal Canadiens (white jerseys) and Dallas Stars (green jerseys) engage in a multi-person on-ice fight near the boards, involving grappling, pushing, and swinging of arms/hockey sticks; referees intervene to separate them.

Two players—one in a white/red Montreal Canadiens jersey and one in a green Dallas Stars jersey (No. 14, Benn)—engage in mutual physical combat near the boards, grabbing each other’s jerseys and helmets, with punches thrown and bodies entangled.

A Montreal Canadiens player (white/red jersey, #8) and a Dallas Stars player (green jersey, #47) engage in mutual physical combat near the boards, exchanging punches and grappling while other players and officials intervene.

A second fight erupts involving a different pair: a Montreal player (No. 11) and a Dallas player (No. 47), who grapple and exchange blows near the same area, while the first fight is still being separated.; After the initial fight is broken up, a second altercation erupts involving another Canadiens player (#8, same as before) and a Stars player (#17, green jersey), with referees actively separating them and sticks being raised or dropped.
